newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow in the Panhandle area late Tuesday. There were not enough sales for a market test at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Last established market was 67.00 in a limited test on Friday. Bids Tuesday were 65.00-66.00, instances 67.00 in the North Plains with asking prices 68.00-70.00. 16,600 head confirmed for the week to date including 300 head or 7 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants and 15,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Heifers - pen breaking utility to choice 2-4 1200 lbs including Heiferettes 61.50.
Wk to Date: 16,600 Week Ago: 77,800 Year Ago: 19,600
